from openpyxl import load_workbook
from copy import copy
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
import re

spreadsheet_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/50630/1_50630_input.xlsx"
output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/50630_0_c4be7f2d/1_50630_output.xlsx"

wb = load_workbook(spreadsheet_path)
ws = wb["Sheet1"]

def split_sentence(sentence):
    # Split case-insensitively on Added and Due, preserving the separators' surrounding text
    s = str(sentence)
    added_match = re.search(r"added", s, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    due_match = re.search(r"due", s, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    if not added_match or not due_match or due_match.start() < added_match.end():
        return None

    name = s[:added_match.start()]
    added_part = s[added_match.end():due_match.start()]
    due_part = s[due_match.end():]

    # Match worked example: no leading space after the keyword, but keep trailing separator
    added_part = added_part.lstrip(" \t\r\n")

    # Due date should be a real Excel date/datetime.
    due_text = due_part.strip(" \t\r\n\u00a0")
    due_date = None
    for fmt in ("%d %b %Y", "%d %B %Y"):
        try:
            due_date = datetime.strptime(due_text, fmt)
            break
        except ValueError:
            pass
    if due_date is None:
        # Fallback for unexpected spacing/case, still using 2021-style dates
        m = re.search(r"(\d{1,2})\s+([A-Za-z]+)\s+(\d{4})", due_text)
        if m:
            due_date = datetime.strptime(" ".join(m.groups()), "%d %b %Y")
        else:
            due_date = due_text

    return name, added_part, due_date

# Cell-level answer range is C5:E6. Fill only rows with source sentences in column A.
for row in range(5, 7):
    source = ws.cell(row=row, column=1).value
    if source is None:
        continue

    result = split_sentence(source)
    if result is None:
        continue

    for col, value in zip(range(3, 6), result):
        cell = ws.cell(row=row, column=col)
        cell.value = value

        # Replicate the worked-example formatting/type presentation by column.
        template = ws.cell(row=4, column=col)
        if template.has_style:
            cell._style = copy(template._style)
        if template.number_format:
            cell.number_format = template.number_format
        if template.alignment:
            cell.alignment = copy(template.alignment)
        if template.font:
            cell.font = copy(template.font)
        if template.fill:
            cell.fill = copy(template.fill)
        if template.border:
            cell.border = copy(template.border)
        if template.protection:
            cell.protection = copy(template.protection)

Path(output_path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
